title: Belvedere
html_source:
Belvedere College SJ is a private Jesuit secondary school for boys on Great Denmark Street, Dublin, Ireland. The school has numerous alumni in the arts, politics, sports, science, and business. Wikipedia
Founded: 1832
Number of students: 1,005

It forms part of the Portrait story.
